Read: card objectui#10844 body and thread (triage `5859979628`, claim `5860160735`; the dev report `5860645315` was read as a list of claims to test, not as evidence); objectui#10110, objectui#10183 (body, `5808988744`, the claim, the dev report, ACCEPT `5816731550`), PR objectui#10266 body and file list, objectui#10026 (body, ruling `5749269396`, the dev report, seat answers `5818142672`, ACCEPT `5818323394`); PR objectui#10861 body, file list (8 files) and its diff against merge-base `4aebea0`; head sources of `DashboardFilterBar.tsx`, `date-picker.tsx` (head and base), `formatValue.ts`, `ReportViewer.tsx` (`renderCellValue` and the summary tiles), `ReportExportEngine.ts`, `date-display.ts` (`toDisplayDate`, `isRealCalendarDate`, `formatDate`), `DatePickerSchema` in `packages/types/src/form.ts`, the driver and the three new pins, `vitest.config.mts` (alias map, `pool`, `TZ`), `.changeset/config.json`, the new changeset and the pending changesets naming touched files (`10799-calendar-default-month`, `10722-date-fns-display-locale`, `10020-report-display-locale`; 10132, 5458 and 10789 checked for date sentences); objectui `AGENTS.md` §5 (#7 No-Touch `ui/`, #11) and §9 (changeset presence, 测试纪律, 版本号策略); the census candidates in plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-timeline, plugin-charts, core `FormulaFunctions.ts`, i18n `formatting.ts` and `spec-formatters.ts`, plugin-detail `InlineFieldInput.tsx` and `HistoryTimeline.tsx`, `custom/date-picker.tsx`, `native-date-value.ts`, `fields/src/index.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `AiPendingActionsInbox.tsx`, apps/console `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, plus a `git grep` of `new Date(`, `Date.parse(` and `date-fns` over `packages/*/src` and `apps/console/src` at the head; objectstack `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/task.object.ts` and `ui/views/task.view.ts`; the head's check-runs (two polls). Ran once, in a throwaway `git worktree` at the head under the scratch dir with an offline `pnpm install` (3.7s), through `os-verify-lock.sh` slot `review-10861`: the driver `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` — 1 file, 9 passed, child exit 0, 18.39s on a shared box, lock held 20s, waited 0s. Also two node probes (date-fns `format`, `isSameDay`, `startOfMonth`; and `toDisplayDate` / `isRealCalendarDate` from core src) under `TZ=UTC`, `America/Los_Angeles`, `Asia/Shanghai`. Worktree removed without `--force`.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. DashboardFilterBar — RIGHT.** At the head `rangeFrom` and `rangeTo` read `toDisplayDate(value.from)` and `toDisplayDate(value.to)` behind the unchanged `!value.from.startsWith('{')` macro guard. `toIsoDate` is untouched and still writes the LOCAL day from `getFullYear`, `getMonth`, `getDate`, and `onSelect` still commits through it, so the write side is unchanged and local. West of UTC: in the driver's forks child under `America/Los_Angeles`, the case "clicking 15 Sep commits the 15th, and the committed range highlights the 15th" passed (committed `from: '2026-09-15', to: '2026-09-15'`; `selected: ['2026-09-15']`; captions `September 2026`, `October 2026`), and "a range stored from 1 Oct highlights 1-3 Oct and opens on October" passed (captions `October 2026`, `November 2026`). The pin's fixture-validity case pins that the engine parse of `2026-09-15` reads the 14th there and that `2026-10-01` reads month 8, so base fails both cases. A refused bound (`2026-02-30`): `toDisplayDate` returns an Invalid Date (probed as raw in all three zones), which reaches the calendar's `selected` from/to pair; the pre-existing `openingMonth` guard (`!Number.isNaN(rangeFrom.getTime())`) withholds it from `defaultMonth`, so the calendar opens on today (frozen clock: `September 2026`), where base rolled it into March and opened on March. Nothing throws: the suite-zone case asserts `selected: []` with captions `September 2026`, `October 2026` for a refused pair, and `not.toThrow` for a valid `from` beside a refused `to`; those cases also ran inside the driver child. No path hands an Invalid Date to date-fns in a throwing position: `defaultMonth` is guarded and react-day-picker's `selected` matching answers false on it (measured by the pin, not assumed). The trigger label from `rangeLabel` still prints the raw stored strings, unchanged.

**2. date-picker `toPickerDay` — RIGHT.** Head: `return typeof value === 'string' && isRealCalendarDate(value) ? toDisplayDate(value) : value;`. `isRealCalendarDate` is `false` for anything but a `YYYY-MM-DD` string whose year, month and day read back, so a `Date` (its `typeof` is `'object'`), a date-time string (fails `ISO_DATE_ONLY_RE`) and any other string pass through as the same reference; the trigger formats `day`, the calendar takes `calendarDay` (a type-only cast), and the muted class still reads `!value`. Base called `format(value, …)` and passed `value` to `defaultMonth` and `selected` directly. For `'not a date'` head and base hand date-fns the identical string: probed `format('not a date', 'PPP')` throws `RangeError: Invalid time value` in UTC, LA and Shanghai, so the trigger throws exactly as before, and (as pending changeset 10799 says of both pickers) before any calendar mounts. For `'2024-02-30'`: `isRealCalendarDate` answers `false`, the string passes unchanged, and date-fns rolls it zone-dependently — probed `March 1st, 2024` in UTC and Shanghai, `February 29th, 2024` in LA — as the PR says; the pin asserts that `face('2024-02-30')` does not throw (an `expect(...).not.toThrow()` over the render), a render and not a refusal. The west case fails on base: probed `format('2024-01-15', 'PPP')` in LA is `January 14th, 2024`; the pin expects `January 15th, 2024`, `selected: ['2024-01-15']`, month `January 2024`. date-fns is `^4.4.0` and react-day-picker `^10.0.1` in `packages/components/package.json`, where a string input takes the engine parse, matching the card's measurement. Nothing under `packages/components/src/ui/` is in the file list.

**3. formatValue — RIGHT.** `ReportViewer.renderCellValue` reaches `formatValue` on two paths: `if (field.aggregation) return formatValue(value, field, displayLocale)` and the untyped fall-through `return formatValue(value, field, displayLocale)`; a typed non-aggregated column goes to `getCellRenderer` (the fields cells, repaired by the earlier cards). The summary tiles call `formatValue(computeAggregation(field.name, field.aggregation), field, displayLocale)`. Inside, `type === 'date' || format === 'date' || isISODateString(value)` routes to the private `formatDate`, which now parses with `toDisplayDate` and reads local getters — a genuine date-only read of a stored day, typed (through an aggregation) or sniffed. Invalid-string face: base returned `String(value)` when the engine parse was NaN; head returns it when `toDisplayDate` is NaN, and for every string that is not date-only shaped `toDisplayDate` returns the engine's own parse (probed `'not a date'`, `'2026-13-01'`, `'2026-09-15xyz'` → raw in all zones), so every string base rendered raw still renders raw. What changes: a date-only nonexistent day (`2026-02-30`: base `2026-03-02`, head the raw `2026-02-30`, probed) and, through the shared step's objectui#10301 branch, a date-time written on a nonexistent day (`2026-02-30T10:00:00Z`: base `2026-03-02`, head raw). The changeset's "A value naming a nonexistent day now renders as the raw stored string" covers both; the PR body's prose names the date-only case only (noted under ③, not a defect). A real date-time keeps its local day (`2026-09-16T04:00:00.000Z` → `2026-09-15` in LA and `2026-09-16` in UTC and Shanghai, probed and pinned). Other callers: `formatValue` is exported from `packages/plugin-report/src/index.tsx`; in-repo the only caller is `ReportViewer` (three sites); `ReportExportEngine` does not call it. The signature `(value, field?, locale = DISPLAY_LOCALE_LAST_RESORT)` is unchanged.

**4. PINS registration — RIGHT.** The driver diff adds exactly three `PINS` entries and header prose; `timeout: 360_000` on the describe, the spawn's `timeout: 300_000`, `--pool=forks`, `OBJECTUI_DATE_ZONE_CHILD=1` and the assertions (collected, ran at least one case, every case `passed`, child exit 0) are unchanged. Each new pin has `describe.runIf(DRIVEN)` blocks for `America/Los_Angeles` and `Asia/Shanghai`, each opening with `rig: the zone really moved` (`Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone` plus the local hour of a fixed instant: 21 and 12 for the September instant, 20 and 12 for the January one), a west `fixture validity` case pinning the engine's day-before, and west cases base fails: dashboard `selected: ['2026-09-15']` and `October 2026` (base: `2026-09-14` and `September 2026`), date-picker `January 15th, 2024` (base: `January 14th, 2024`, probed), formatValue `2026-09-15` (base: `2026-09-14`). The PR's three ablation legs name exactly these cases. The only skip in the parent is the driver convention's `runIf(DRIVEN)`. My driver run: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 9 passed (9)` — the eight registered pins, including the three new ones, and the child-exit case.

**5. The census — RIGHT, with two notes.** Verified at the head:
- plugin-calendar. `ObjectCalendar` builds `const start = new Date(startDate)` and `end: endDate ? new Date(endDate) : undefined` from `record[startDateField]` / `record[endDateField]`; `calendar-view-renderer` builds `start: new Date(record[startField])` and `resolveAuthoredCurrentDate` parses `new Date(raw)`; `CalendarView.getEventsForDate` compares `new Date(event.start)` against a local day. Producer: objectstack `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/task.object.ts` declares `due_date: Field.date`, `start_date: Field.date`, `end_date: Field.date` (and `created_at: Field.datetime`); `ui/views/task.view.ts` binds `calendar: { startDateField: 'due_date', titleField: 'title', colorField: 'status' }` in the switcher and in the named `calendar` list view; the seed fills `due_date` with the calendar-day helpers `daysFromNow` / `daysAgo`. Write-back: the drop handler patches `[startDateField]: newStart.toISOString()` (and `endDateField`), and quick-create writes `quickCreate.start.toISOString()` — a UTC instant into a `Field.date`, so the PR is right that read and write must be decided together.
- plugin-gantt. `ObjectGantt` maps `start: startDate ? new Date(startDate) : new Date()`, `end` likewise, baselines `new Date(baselineStartRaw)`; `GanttView` parses `startDate`, `endDate` and `m.date` and re-bases every `Date` through `tzShift`; write-back `patch[startDateField] = changes.start.toISOString()`. Producer: the same task object's `start_date` / `end_date`, bound by `task.view.ts` `gantt: { startDateField: 'start_date', endDateField: 'end_date', ... }`.
- plugin-timeline. `ObjectTimeline.dateBucket` reads `startOfDay(new Date(raw))` and the sort reads `new Date(a.startDate).getTime()`; `renderer.formatDate` reads `new Date(dateString)` with local faces for `short` and `long` and `toISOString().split('T')[0]` by default; the extent parses `new Date(d).getTime()` then prints `toISOString()`. The showcase binds `created_at` (a datetime), so no showcase date-only producer, as the PR says.
- plugin-charts. `AdvancedChartImpl.formatTick` parses `new Date(str)` for `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}` then `toLocaleDateString`, falling back to `toISOString().slice(0, 10)`.
- core. `FormulaFunctions` DATEADD, DATEDIFF and DATEFORMAT parse `new Date(dateStr)` and read local getters; TODAY, NOW and DATEADD emit `toISOString()`.
- i18n. `formatting.ts` `formatDate`, `formatDateTime`, `formatRelativeTime` and `spec-formatters.ts` `formatDateSpec` parse `new Date(date)`; the only in-repo mention outside the package is `packages/i18n/README.md`.
- Adjacent write. `InlineFieldInput.tsx`: `onChange(v ? new Date(v + 'T00:00:00').toISOString() : v)`.
Missing from the list: no same-class site found. Every other `new Date(x)` or `Date.parse(x)` hit in `packages/*/src` is an audit or event instant (app-shell pages, plugin-detail `HistoryTimeline` and `RecordMetaFooter` on `created_at`, the activity feeds, the chatbot inbox, designer, ai, collaboration, auth), arithmetic or a copy (date-macros, the CalendarView grid, GanttView, scheduling, shifts, ResourceWorkload, timeline interpolation), a validity guard ahead of the shared path (data-table, the ObjectGrid sniff, dashboard-filters, dataset-format, ImportWizard, importParsers), the validation engine's symmetric min/max compare, or already on `toDisplayDate` (date-display, native-date-value's verbatim date-only pass-through, the fields cells and widgets, DetailView, auditHistoryDisplay, `calendar.tsx`, data-table, GridField's documented datetime arm). apps/console `ApprovalsInboxPage.formatPayloadValue` parses only `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T\d{2}` strings and returns a date-only string raw, so it is not a member. Already correct among the six listed: none — each still parses with the engine at the head.
